instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
prompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious silver decorative wedding envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground with a strong central presence in a vertical 9:16 frame. The envelope has an elegant, refined and handcrafted appearance, crafted from premium soft matte paper with subtle fibers, pearlescent silver sheen and delicate metallic accents. Its folds are precise, clean and realistic, with sophisticated embossed details and a polished silver ribbon. The wax seal is finely detailed and tactile, featuring two intertwined wedding rings engraved into the seal, clearly visible and symbolizing eternal union. The envelope is placed within a luxurious nocturnal wedding setting, such as an elegant garden terrace illuminated by soft silver lanterns, with subtle architectural details, white flowers, delicate foliage and distant twinkling lights creating depth and context. Surrounding elements include white rose petals, tiny silver sparkles and softly floating luminous particles arranged organically around the envelope, enhancing the romantic atmosphere without overpowering the main subject. Cinematic dramatic lighting with a soft cool key light illuminating the envelope, delicate rim light outlining its edges, subtle volumetric light rays from behind, atmospheric haze and gentle mist catching the light. Soft, realistic directional shadows, controlled contrast and luminous highlights. Intentional monochromatic silver color palette with ivory white accents, cool gray gradients and elegant metallic reflections, creating a sophisticated, timeless and premium wedding invitation aesthetic. Foreground-focused composition, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused but visually recognizable, strong sense of depth and perspective. Macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the paper texture, silver ribbon, wax seal and engraved intertwined wedding rings, cinematic bokeh in the background. Photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic elegance, luxurious, romantic, premium editorial photography, cinematic fantasy realism. 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range, refined composition, editorial-grade rendering, suitable for an elegant wedding invitation.
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring an elegant blank sheet of paper as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying almost the entire frame while leaving visible space around it to reveal the floor, background and carefully arranged lateral elements. The sheet is perfectly clean and intentionally empty, with no text, letters, symbols, logos or writing, preserving a refined surface for future customization. Its material is premium and tactile, with realistic paper fibers, subtle soft-matte texture, delicate pearlescent finish and understated silver accents along the edges. The sheet has precise geometry, gently raised corners and natural folds, resting elegantly on a sophisticated floor with realistic contact shadows.

The environment is rich and visually contextualized rather than a flat backdrop, featuring an elegant silver-themed setting with softly blurred architectural details, refined decorative panels and subtle metallic surfaces in the background. Around the sheet, curated ornamental elements create a graceful frame: silver foliage, delicate white flowers, satin ribbons, small pearls, crystal ornaments, elegant filigree details and a few subtle reflective particles arranged organically along the sides without covering the central blank area. The lateral adornments add depth and sophistication while keeping the sheet as the unmistakable hero of the composition.

Lighting is cinematic and luxurious, with a soft diffused key light illuminating the paper surface, delicate cool rim light defining its silhouette and gentle volumetric rays entering from above. Subtle atmospheric haze, faint silver sparkles and controlled reflections enhance the elegant mood. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional, with natural ambient occlusion where the sheet meets the floor. Color palette dominated by silver, platinum, pearl white and soft gray, with harmonious gradients, luminous highlights and controlled contrast.

Composition: vertical foreground-focused arrangement, blank sheet sharply in focus, nearly filling the frame, with visible floor, background and lateral negative space, balanced symmetry, refined perspective and strong depth. Camera: macro editorial photography look, slightly elevated angle, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the paper texture and ornaments, soft cinematic bokeh in the background. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, elegant, sophisticated, premium editorial invitation aesthetic, minimalist luxury, cinematic realism. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range, flawless composition. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, refined and visually enchanting. Negative prompt: text, handwriting, letters, typography, symbols, logos, watermark, clutter, excessive ornaments covering the sheet, distorted paper, torn edges, harsh shadows, flat lighting, low resolution, oversaturated colors, cartoon style.
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão vertical 9:16 elegante, na mesma atmosfera, no tema (Elegante) e na paleta de cores (Prata). Como identificação do evento, escreva apenas "Casamento Júlia e Marcelo". Escreva também a frase exata "Clique para abrir o convite!". Copie ambas literalmente, sem acrescentar idade, data, horário, endereço ou outros dizeres, e deixe-as visíveis, legíveis e integradas ao design.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
aberturaSlide2Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
